title: PrimeVarClass: domain-aware, externally validated classification of BRCA1/BRCA2 missense variants of uncertain significance
description: An open, reproducible and interpretable classifier for missense variants of uncertain significance (VUS) in BRCA1/BRCA2. It combines a curated functional-domain map with zero-shot ESM-2 protein language-model scores under a strict anti-leakage validation protocol, is statistically comparable to state-of-the-art predictors (AlphaMissense, REVEL, CADD), calibrates its score to ACMG/AMP evidence strength (PP3/BP4), decomposes each detected variant's structural mechanism, addresses ancestry equity in variant resolution, and publishes a timestamped prospective prediction registry.
